_comment: Plugin manifest (authored by the plugin author). 'version' is the plugin semver (release-only); install-plugin reads 'setup'.
name: docker-home
description: A per-project Linux container that runs the coding harness (claude, codex, opencode) with only the project folder and its own home directory bind-mounted, so nothing above the project (framework, other projects, host dotfiles) exists for the agent. Shortcut scripts dh-build/start/stop/enter/status/rebuild/remove.sh manage it from a terminal; the skill drives the same scripts strictly on the user's request; per-host state lives under ~/.solaris/docker-home/<slug>/. Meant for long-lived agent sessions on Linux hosts holding a synced Solaris tree; Linux-only inside.

notes: Requires Docker on the machine where sessions run: Docker Desktop on macOS, docker-ce on Linux with your user in the docker group (`docker info` without sudo). GPU pass-through needs the NVIDIA container toolkit.
Nothing is built or started at attach time. Say 'build docker home' when you want the container; the first build asks the per-host options (GPUs, network, extra mounts) once.
Linux inside: projects that need macOS-native tooling (Xcode) cannot use a docker home.
Per-host state lives under ~/.solaris/docker-home/<slug>/ (the container's home directory + dh.conf): machine-local, never in the repo, removed by dh-remove.sh.
